segments.mn108:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe aciraparinibbute bhagavati.
segments.mn108:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājagahaṃ paṭisaṅkhārāpeti rañño pajjotassa āsaṅkamāno.
segments.mn108:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.mn108:3.4: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto, yena gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkameyyan”ti.
segments.mn108:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto, yena gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.mn108:4.2: Addasā kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.mn108:4.6: Cirassaṃ kho bhavaṃ ānando imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
segments.mn108:4.8: Nisīdi kho āyasmā ānando paññatte āsane.
segments.mn108:4.9: Gopakamoggallānopi kho brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn108:4.10: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn108:5.1: “atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho”ti?
segments.mn108:5.2: “Natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
segments.mn108:5.3: So hi, brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido;
segments.mn108:5.4: maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā”ti.
segments.mn108:6.1: Ayañca hidaṃ āyasmato ānandassa gopakamoggallānena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ antarākathā vippakatā ahosi.
segments.mn108:6.2: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rājagahe kammante anusaññāyamāno yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto, yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn108:6.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn108:6.4: “kāyanuttha, bho ānanda, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā”ti?
segments.mn108:6.6: ‘atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti.
segments.mn108:6.7: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, gopakamoggallānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn108:6.8: ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
segments.mn108:6.9: So hi, brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido;
segments.mn108:6.10: maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā’ti.
segments.mn108:6.11: Ayaṃ kho no, brāhmaṇa, gopakamoggallānena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ antarākathā vippakatā.
segments.mn108:7.1: “Atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:7.2: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā”ti [paṭidhāveyyāthāti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)]?
segments.mn108:7.3: “Natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:7.4: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā”ti.
segments.mn108:8.1: “Atthi pana, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:8.2: ‘ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā”ti?
segments.mn108:8.3: “Natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:8.4: ‘ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā”ti.
segments.mn108:9.1: “Evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā”ti?
segments.mn108:10.1: “‘Atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:10.2: ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā’ti –
segments.mn108:10.3: iti puṭṭho samāno ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:10.4: ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā’ti vadesi;
segments.mn108:10.5: ‘atthi pana, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:10.6: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā’ti –
segments.mn108:10.7: iti puṭṭho samāno ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:10.8: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā’ti –
segments.mn108:10.10: ‘evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, appaṭisaraṇā;
segments.mn108:10.13: Imassa pana, bho ānanda, bhāsitassa kathaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.mn108:10.14: “Atthi kho, brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, pātimokkhaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ.
segments.mn108:10.15: Te mayaṃ tadahuposathe yāvatikā ekaṃ gāmakhettaṃ upanissāya viharāma te sabbe ekajjhaṃ sannipatāma;
segments.mn108:10.16: sannipatitvā yassa taṃ pavattati taṃ ajjhesāma.
segments.mn108:10.17: Tasmiṃ ce bhaññamāne hoti bhikkhussa āpatti hoti vītikkamo taṃ mayaṃ yathādhammaṃ yathānusiṭṭhaṃ kāremāti.
segments.mn108:11.1: “Atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi yaṃ tumhe etarahi sakkarotha garuṃ karotha [garukarotha (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] mānetha pūjetha; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā [garukatvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] upanissāya viharathā”ti?
segments.mn108:11.2: “Natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garuṃ karoma mānema pūjema; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharāmā”ti.
segments.mn108:11.3: “‘Atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:11.4: ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā’ti –
segments.mn108:11.5: iti puṭṭho samāno ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:12.1: ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā’ti vadesi;
segments.mn108:12.2: ‘atthi pana, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:12.3: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭipādeyyāthā’ti –
segments.mn108:12.4: iti puṭṭho samāno ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito –
segments.mn108:12.5: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭipādeyyāmā’ti vadesi;
segments.mn108:12.6: ‘atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhupi yaṃ tumhe etarahi sakkarotha garuṃ karotha mānetha pūjetha; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharathā’ti –
segments.mn108:12.7: iti puṭṭho samāno ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garuṃ karoma mānema pūjema; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharāmā’ti vadesi.
segments.mn108:12.8: Imassa pana, bho ānanda, bhāsitassa kathaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.mn108:13.1: “Atthi kho, brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa pasādanīyā dhammā akkhātā.
segments.mn108:13.2: Yasmiṃ no ime dhammā saṃvijjanti taṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garuṃ karoma mānema pūjema; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharāma.
segments.mn108:14.1: “Idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
segments.mn108:15.2: Ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā, majjhekalyāṇā, pariyosānakalyāṇā, sātthaṃ, sabyañjanaṃ [sātthā sabyañjanā (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadantntti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā [dhatā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
segments.mn108:17.1: “Catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.mn108:18.1: “Anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti; āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ; tirokuṭṭaṃ [tirokuḍḍaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse; pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti, seyyathāpi udake; udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati, seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ; ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo; imepi candimasūriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati [parāmasati (ka.)] parimajjati, yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
segments.mn108:19.1: “Dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti – dibbe ca mānuse ca, ye dūre santike ca.
segments.mn108:20.7: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītamohaṃ cittan’ti pajānāti, saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘saṃkhittaṃ cittan’ti pajānāti,
segments.mn108:21.1: “Anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe – ‘amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ; tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. Iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
segments.mn108:22.1: “Dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
segments.mn108:23.1: “Āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn108:23.2: “Ime kho, brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa pasādanīyā dhammā akkhātā.
segments.mn108:23.3: Yasmiṃ no ime dhammā saṃvijjanti taṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garuṃ karoma mānema pūjema; sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharāmā”ti.
segments.mn108:24.1: Evaṃ vutte vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto upanandaṃ senāpatiṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn108:24.2: “taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ senāpati [maññasi evaṃ senāpati (syā. kaṃ. pī.), maññasi senāpati (sī.), maññasi bhavaṃ senāpati (ka.)] yadime bhonto sakkātabbaṃ sakkaronti, garuṃ kātabbaṃ garuṃ karonti,
segments.mn108:24.4: “Tagghime [taggha me (ka.)] bhonto sakkātabbaṃ sakkaronti, garuṃ kātabbaṃ garuṃ karonti, mānetabbaṃ mānenti, pūjetabbaṃ pūjenti.
segments.mn108:24.5: Imañca hi te bhonto na sakkareyyuṃ na garuṃ kareyyuṃ na māneyyuṃ na pūjeyyuṃ;
segments.mn108:24.6: atha kiñcarahi te bhonto sakkareyyuṃ garuṃ kareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā mānetvā pūjetvā upanissāya vihareyyun”ti?
segments.mn108:25.1: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn108:25.4: “Kacci pana, bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhasseyyakaṃ [manussarāhaseyyakaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paṭisallānasāruppan”ti?
segments.mn108:25.5: “Taggha, brāhmaṇa, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhasseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ, yathā taṃ tumhādisehi rakkhakehi gopakehī”ti.
segments.mn108:25.6: “Taggha, bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhasseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ, yathā taṃ bhavantehi jhāyīhi jhānasīlīhi.
segments.mn108:25.8: “Ekamidāhaṃ, bho ānanda, samayaṃ so bhavaṃ gotamo vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.mn108:25.9: Atha khvāhaṃ, bho ānanda, yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā yena so bhavaṃ gotamo tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
segments.mn108:25.10: Tatra ca pana so [tatra ca so (sī. pī.)] bhavaṃ gotamo anekapariyāyena jhānakathaṃ kathesi.
segments.mn108:25.11: Jhāyī ceva so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi jhānasīlī ca.
segments.mn108:25.12: Sabbañca pana so bhavaṃ gotamo jhānaṃ vaṇṇesī”ti.
segments.mn108:26.1: “Na ca kho, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ vaṇṇesi, napi so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesīti.
segments.mn108:26.2: Kathaṃ rūpañca, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesi?
segments.mn108:26.3: Idha, brāhmaṇa, ekacco kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
segments.mn108:26.4: so kāmarāgaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
segments.mn108:26.5: Byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena, uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
segments.mn108:26.6: so byāpādaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
segments.mn108:26.7: Thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thinamiddhaparetena, uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
segments.mn108:26.8: so thinamiddhaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
segments.mn108:26.9: Uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena, uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
segments.mn108:26.10: so uddhaccakukkuccaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
segments.mn108:26.11: Vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
segments.mn108:26.12: so vicikicchaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
segments.mn108:26.13: Evarūpaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesi.
segments.mn108:27.1: “Kathaṃ rūpañca, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ vaṇṇesi?
segments.mn108:27.2: Idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn108:27.3: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe …
segments.mn108:27.6: Evarūpaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ vaṇṇesī”ti.
segments.mn108:28.1: “Gārayhaṃ kira, bho ānanda, so bhavaṃ gotamo jhānaṃ garahi, pāsaṃsaṃ pasaṃsi.
segments.mn108:28.2: Handa, ca dāni mayaṃ, bho ānanda, gacchāma;
segments.mn108:28.5: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.mn108:29.1: Atha kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo acirapakkante vassakāre brāhmaṇe magadhamahāmatte āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn108:29.2: “yaṃ no mayaṃ bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ apucchimhā taṃ no bhavaṃ ānando na byākāsī”ti.
segments.mn108:29.4: ‘natthi kho, brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhupi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
segments.mn108:29.5: So hi, brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido.
segments.mn108:29.6: Maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā’”ti.

lines: Tattha aciraparinibbute bhagavatīti bhagavati aciraparinibbute, dhātubhājanīyaṃ katvā dhammasaṅgītiṃ kātuṃ rājagahaṃ āgatakāle.

Rañño pajjotassa āsaṅkamānoti caṇḍapajjoto nāmesa rājā bimbisāramahārājassa sahāyo ahosi, jīvakaṃ pesetvā bhesajjakāritakālato paṭṭhāya pana daḷhamittova jāto, so “ajātasattunā devadattassa vacanaṃ gahetvā pitā ghātito”ti sutvā “mama piyamittaṃ ghātetvā esa rajjaṃ karissāmīti maññati, mayhaṃ sahāyassa sahāyānaṃ atthikabhāvaṃ jānāpessāmī”ti parisati vācaṃ abhāsi.
Upasaṅkamīti mayaṃ dhammavinayasaṅgītiṃ kāressāmāti vicarāma, ayañca mahesakkho rājavallabho saṅgahe kate veḷuvanassa ārakkhaṃ kareyyāti maññamāno upasaṅkami.
Cha hi satthāro paṭhamataraṃ appaññātakulehi nikkhamitvā pabbajitā, te tathāgate dharamāneyeva kālaṃkatā, sāvakāpi nesaṃ appaññātakuleheva pabbajitā.
Samaṇo pana gotamo mahākulā pabbajito, tassa accayena sāvakānaṃ mahāvivādo bhavissatīti ayaṃ kathā sakalajambudīpaṃ pattharamānā udapādi.
Sammāsambuddhe ca dharante bhikkhūnaṃ vivādo nāhosi.

“aṭṭhasaṭṭhiyojanasatasahassubbedhaṃ sineruṃ apavāhituṃ samatthassa vātassa purato purāṇapaṇṇaṃ kiṃ ṭhassati, dasa pāramiyo pūretvā sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ pattassa satthu alajjamāno maccurājā kassa lajjissatī”ti mahāsaṃvegaṃ janetvā bhiyyosomattāya bhikkhū samaggā jātā ativiya upasantupasantā, kiṃ nu kho etanti idaṃ pucchāmīti pucchati.
Ko hetu sāmaggiyāti tumhākaṃ samaggabhāvassa ko hetu ko paccayo.
Dhammappaṭisaraṇāti dhammo amhākaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, dhammo avassayoti dīpeti.
Yathādhammaṃ yathānusiṭṭhaṃ kāremāti yathā dhammo ca anusiṭṭhi ca ṭhitā, evaṃ kāremāti attho.
Na kira no bhavanto kārenti dhammo no kāretīti padadvayepi no kāro nipātamattaṃ.
Evaṃ sante na kira bhavanto kārenti, dhammova kāretīti ayamettha attho.
Kahaṃ pana bhavaṃ ānandoti kiṃ therassa veḷuvane vasanabhāvaṃ na jānātīti?
Veḷuvanassa pana anena ārakkhā dinnā, tasmā attānaṃ ukkaṃsāpetukāmo pucchati.
Kasmā pana tena tattha ārakkhā dinnā?
So kira ekadivasaṃ mahākaccāyanattheraṃ gijjhakūṭā otarantaṃ disvā –
No ce khamāpeti, imasmiṃ veḷuvane gonaṅgalamakkaṭo bhavissatī”ti āha.
“samaṇassa gotamassa kathāya dvedhābhāvo nāma natthi, pacchā me makkaṭabhūtakāle gocaraṭṭhānaṃ bhavissatī”ti veḷuvane nānāvidhe rukkhe ropetvā ārakkhaṃ adāsi.
Aparabhāge kālaṃ katvā makkaṭo hutvā nibbatti.
Taggha, bho ānandāti evaṃ therena parisamajjhe attano ukkaṃsitabhāvaṃ ñatvā ahampi theraṃ ukkaṃsissāmīti evamāha.

Na ca kho, brāhmaṇāti thero kira cintesi “sammāsambuddhena vaṇṇitajjhānampi atthi, avaṇṇitajjhānampi atthi, ayaṃ pana brāhmaṇo sabbameva vaṇṇetīti pañhaṃ visaṃvādeti, na kho pana sakkā imassa mukhaṃ ulloketuṃ na piṇḍapātaṃ rakkhituṃ, pañhaṃ ujuṃ katvā kathessāmī”ti idaṃ vattuṃ āraddhaṃ.
Evarūpaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ vaṇṇesīti idha sabbasaṅgāhakajjhānaṃ nāma kathitaṃ.

Yaṃ no mayanti ayaṃ kira brāhmaṇo vassakārabrāhmaṇaṃ usūyati, tena pucchitapañhassa akathanaṃ paccāsīsamāno kathitabhāvaṃ ñatvā “vassakārena pucchitaṃ pañhaṃ punappunaṃ tassa nāmaṃ gaṇhanto vitthāretvā kathesi, mayā pucchitapañhaṃ pana yaṭṭhikoṭiyā uppīḷento viya ekadesameva kathesī”ti anattamano ahosi, tasmā evamāha.

lines: Kammaṃyeva kammanto, so ettha atthīti kammakaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ “kammanto”ti vuttaṃ.
Sabbena sabbanti sabbappakārena anavasesaṃ, ettako guṇānaṃ pakārabhedo, tesu kiñcipi pakāraṃ anavasesetvā.
Sabbakoṭṭhāsehi sabbanti yattakā guṇabhāgā, tehi sabbehi anavasesaṃ nissesameva katvā.
Yopi ahosīti yopi kosambivāsīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasena kosambiyaṃ kalaho ahosi.
Bhiyyosomattāya bhikkhū samaggā jātā, kathañca saṃvego jātoti dassetuṃ “aṭṭhasaṭṭhī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Anusaṃyāyamānoti anu anu sammadeva jānanto vicārento vosāsamāno.
Tattha ya-kārassa ña-kāraṃ katvā niddesoti āha “anuvicaramāno”ti.
So hi “tehi dhammehī”tiādinā,“atthi koci tumhākaṃ sāsanassa sārabhūto bhikkhū”ti pucchi.
Appaṭisaraṇeti yaṃ tumhe bhikkhuṃ paṭibodheyyātha, tādisassa abhāvena appaṭisaraṇe.
Dhammo noti ettha no -saddo avadhāraṇe “na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatenā”tiādīsu (khu. pā.6.3; su. ni.226) viya.
“Yathā taṃ tumhādisehi rakkhakehi gopakehī”ti evaṃ pasannavesena attānaṃ ukkaṃsāpetukāmo.
Ariyūpavādapāpaṃ khamāpane sati antarāyāya na hotīti āha –
Ayaṃ ukkaṃsāpetuṃ icchitaṃ yathāraddhamatthaṃ visaṃvādeti avaṇṇitampi vaṇṇitaṃ katvā kathento;
imassa vacanassa paṭikkhepena iminā dātabbapiṇḍapātassa antarāyo mā hotūti evaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ rakkhituṃ na kho pana sakkāti yojanā.
Abbhantaraṃ karitvāti nibbānantogadhaṃ katvā, antaraṃ vā tassa nijjhānassa kāraṇaṃ katvā.
Sabbasaṅgāhikajjhānanti lokiyalokuttarassa antarāyo mā hotūti evaṃ katvāpi rūpāvacarassa maggajhānassa phalajhānassāti sabbassapi saṅgaṇhanavasena desitattā sabbasaṅgāhakajjhānaṃ nāma kathitaṃ.
Mandapaññatāya vassakāragataissābhibhūtacittatāya paripuṇṇaṃ katvā vuttampi atthaṃ anupadhārento āha –
